_comment: Business-logic blocks. These are the ones the SLM writes. Unlike tasks.json entries, these run no model - they consume typed results and emit events.

_schema.requires: semantic tags this block needs on its input. Edge is illegal if the producer does not emit one of these.
_schema.needs_fields: fields that must be present on the input. A producer that lacks one cannot feed this block.
_schema.frames: how many frames of history the kernel sees. 1 = stateless, 2 = previous and current, n = window.
_schema.libraries: external libraries the generated code may use. Empty means none.
_schema.emits: semantic tag of what this block produces

line_crossing.rule: A track crossed when the sign of sideOfLine changes between the previous frame and the current one, for the same track_id.
line_crossing.why_track_id: without track_id you cannot tell that the person in frame N is the same one from frame N-1, so crossing is undecidable.

tailgating.rule: Emit when min_persons or more DISTINCT track_ids cross within window_us of each other.
tailgating.note: can consume raw detections in a zone, OR crossings from line_crossing. The second form is the composable one.

zone_occupancy.rule: Emit when min_persons or more distinct tracks have their box centre inside the polygon.

intrusion.rule: Emit when any tracked object of the configured class is inside the polygon.

loitering.rule: Emit when a single track has been continuously inside the polygon for dwell_us.
loitering.note: needs persistent per-track state. Hardest of the single-camera blocks - see nimbus_lattice ladder L5 reasoning.

crop.rule: Produce a sub-region of the input box. The emitted semantic tag is derived, not fixed - see semantics.md 'crop is semantically transparent'.
crop.note: THE IMPORTANT ONE. Cropping the top of a person box gives you a candidate head region - NOT a region.face. Only face_detection can assert region.face.

direction_filter.rule: Pass through only crossings whose direction matches. Drop the rest.

correlate.rule: Match an event on one camera with an event on another within window_us.
correlate.why_not_generated: TWO input edges, persistent state, expiry, and removal on match. Same 40 lines for every workflow. Hand-write it once, test it hard, reuse it. Getting expiry wrong leaks memory in a service that runs for months.
